subsystem: Apple Video Encoder 2 (AVE2) Motion Estimation Coprocessor Hardware Architecture

target_hardware.soc: Apple Silicon A19 Pro (t8150) / Apple H18 Generation

hmesc.name: Hierarchical Motion Estimation and Spatial Complexity

registers.HMESCSRCPIXRD_CTXCFG_SRCADDR: 64-bit source pixel read context DMA base address
registers.HMESCSRCPIXRD_CTXCFG_STRIDE: Source pixel stride and compression enable flag
registers.ProcessHMESCStart: Trigger register to start hierarchical search execution
registers.HMESCDone: Hardware interrupt status register signaling pass completion

algorithm.spatial_complexity_metric: Per-macroblock directional luma variance (H, V, D45, D135) for adaptive QP modulation
algorithm.motion_candidate_seed_generation: Hierarchical quadtree candidate propagation from Level 3 to Level 0

search_window.search_pattern: Diamond search with early termination threshold

dma_interfaces.ConfigRdDMALowResRCPrvRslts: Previous pass motion vector feedback buffer
dma_interfaces.ConfigHwBlockWrDMA: Coarse motion vector field output DMA writer

multi_pass_rate_control.function: Extracts coarse temporal correlation and bits-per-macroblock budget before high-resolution full-pel search

dmv.name: Dense Motion Vector Engine
dmv.interpolation_filter: 8-tap DCT-based interpolation filter for half-pel and 4-tap filter for quarter-pel
dmv.vector_density: 1 motion vector per 4x4 sub-block in 8K frames

mctf.name: Motion-Compensated Temporal Filtering
mctf.buffer_management: MCTF LFSRef buffers num %d (manages 3 past and 1 future temporal reference frames)
mctf.noise_reduction_kernel: Motion-adaptive temporal IIR/FIR filter blending along estimated motion trajectories, eliminating sensor photon noise before quantization

AVE3.name: SubPelMotionSearch
AVE3.role: Executes fractional sub-pel refinement on DMV candidate vectors

AVE4.name: MVCandidateSifter
AVE4.role: Evaluates spatial (A0, A1, B0, B1, B2) and temporal (Colocated) motion vector predictors

AVE5.name: RDOAndSkipDecision
AVE5.role: Lagrangian Cost = Distortion + Lambda * Bits; decides early SKIP mode

AVE8.name: CoreArbitrator
AVE8.role: Controls hardware clock gating and power state transitions across all ME blocks
